0x001520.en: 「For His Majesty, this life!/ I'll gladly lay it down!」

0x001576.en: 「However slim the hope,/　if there's a chance, I won't give up!」

0x0015D5.en: 「The power of my lovingly tuned/ Blowel Custom.../ I'll show it to you now!」

0x001653.en: 「Mistake my machine for some/　mass-produced unit/　and you'll regret it!」

0x0016C5.en: 「I know it's a road I shouldn't take.../　but walking it may serve those who follow.」

0x0018B0.en: 「Mm.../　Your Majesty, I've failed you.../　Forgive me...!」

0x00190D.en: 「Ngh... even all these/　upgrades aren't enough...?」

0x001969.en: 「So this is the end.../　My regret, Your Majesty...!」

0x0019E7.en: 「T-to think my Blowel Custom/ would be pushed back this far...!」

0x001B14.en: 「Sir Masaki!/　I can't back down here either!」

0x001BE5.en: 「Nnh, the Masou Kishin.../　not to be scorned...!!」

0x001C4B.en: 「Tsh!/　But a scratch like this is nothing!」

0x001C92.en: 「Hmph! I won't fall to this yet!」

0x001CEE.en: 「Without the reinforced armor,/　that would've been dangerous...!」

0x001D81.en: 「Ngh, Cybuster... I must go all out!」

0x001DF5.en: 「How do you like the defense/ of my Blowel Custom?」

0x001E8B.en: 「Yes, that's my machine for you./　Attacks like this can't touch it.」

0x001EE4.en: 「This Blowel Custom hasn't been/ upgraded so many times for nothing.」

0x001F4F.en: 「For durability,/ no ordinary magic mecha compares.」

0x001FA8.en: 「Sir Masaki, no need to hold back!」

0x002004.en: 「Sir Yang Long, your thrust falls short.」

0x002041.en: 「Is that all surface/　machines amount to?」

0x00208B.en: 「Even a Masou Kishin, if that's all you've got!」

0x002109.en: 「My Blowel Custom yields to none/ in mobility either.」

0x002223.en: 「Ngh, how careless of me/　to neglect my ammo count...!」

0x00236A.en: 「Your Majesty, stand back! I'll handle this!」

0x0023D2.en: 「Off balance, are you? Then I'll spare no mercy!」

0x002412.en: 「This is a battlefield!/ You showed an opening, so blame yourself!」
